theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_cs_translate_boundary_eval
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (t : Euclid P), Y.boundary = X → IsTestForm γ → currentEval Y (fun y => exteriorDerivative γ (t + y)) = currentEval X (fun y => γ (t + y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
